driverInstallation.windows: Download Kyocera TASKalfa 7054ci KX driver from Kyocera website. Install driver package which includes PCL and PostScript options. Use KX driver for best performance and feature access. Configure device settings in driver for finishing options.
driverInstallation.mac: Download macOS driver package from Kyocera support. Install PKG file and add printer via System Preferences > Printers & Scanners. Use Kyocera PPD for full feature support. Supports AirPrint for basic printing.
driverInstallation.linux: Download Linux PPD from Kyocera. Install via CUPS web interface at localhost:631. Configure using device IP address. Most features supported via CUPS including duplex and color management.

configPages.meterPage: Touchscreen: Status/Job Cancel > Counter. Shows total, copy, print counters by color.
configPages.configPage: Touchscreen: System Menu > Report > Configuration Page
configPages.networkConfigPage: System Menu > Report > Network Status List
configPages.webInterface: Access Command Center RX at http://[device-ip]. Default login: Admin with custom password set during setup. Provides device management, user authentication, job accounting, and detailed configuration.
